note: Promoter and public holding from NSE's shareholding filing master, latest quarter per company, plus index membership. 2421 companies, 495 of them in a major index.

cautions.no_weights: Index WEIGHTS and points contributed are deliberately not published. A weight needs free-float market cap, which needs SHARES OUTSTANDING - and no free source here provides it: NSE's quote API returns 403 without a browser session, Yahoo's quote endpoints return 401, and the index files carry membership only. Membership and free float are exact; a weight would be a guess dressed as a number.
cautions.free_float_is_a_proxy: free_float_proxy_pct is 100 minus the promoter stake. NSE's own factor also removes government holdings, ADR/GDR and locked-in shares, so the true float is usually somewhat lower.
cautions.quarterly: Shareholding is filed quarterly, so a row can be up to three months old. The filing date is shown on every row.
cautions.revisions: Some companies revise earlier filings. Only the latest date per symbol is kept, so a revision that arrives late replaces the original.
